Here is the issue description:
# `sberror` not clearing properly causes OpenOCD interoperability issues
The OpenTitan project uses GDB/OpenOCD to develop top-level debug and manufacturing test cases. We have noticed some test failures when performing unaligned system bus accesses (see [here](https://github.com/lowRISC/opentitan/issues/17729#issuecomment-1488923308)).
In short, when an unaligned read operation is performed, `sberror` is set to 3 (which is correct according to the spec), but after, OpenOCD tries to clear the error with a W1C, by sending 0x7, however, the `sberror` field fails to clear. We believe there is an RTL bug described [here](https://github.com/lowRISC/opentitan/issues/17729#issuecomment-1489076212).
Could someone confirm / fix?
